<record_update table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><name>Default VIP assignment group</name><collection>incident</collection><when>before</when><order>100</order><active>true</active><advanced>true</advanced><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_update>true</action_update><script>(function executeRule(current, previous /*null when async*/) {
    if (current.caller_id.vip != true) {

    if (groupId) {
        current.setValue('assignment_group', groupId);
    }
})(current, previous);</script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_id>c0ffee0000000000000000000000000b</sys_id><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope></sys_script></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><name>TaskMetrics</name><api_name>global.TaskMetrics</api_name><client_callable>false</client_callable><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><script>var TaskMetrics = Class.create();
TaskMetrics.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {},

    countOpen: function(table) {
        var agg = new GlideAggregate(table);
        agg.addActiveQuery();
        agg.addAggregate('COUNT');
        agg.query();
        return agg.next() ? parseInt(agg.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) : 0;
    },

    groupsForMembers: function(userIds) {
        var groups = [];
        var m = new GlideRecord('sys_user_grmember');
        m.addQuery('user', 'IN', userIds.join(','));
        m.query();
        while (m.next()) {
            groups.push(m.getValue('group'));
        }
        return groups;
    },

    type: 'TaskMetrics'
};</script><sys_id>c0ffee0000000000000000000000000d</sys_id><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope></sys_script_include></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><name>WorkOrderHelper</name><api_name>x_demo_fieldsvc.WorkOrderHelper</api_name><client_callable>false</client_callable><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><script>var WorkOrderHelper = Class.create();
WorkOrderHelper.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {},

    assignTechnician: function(workOrder) {
        gs.debug('Assigning technician for {0}', workOrder.getValue('number'));
        try {
            var tech = new GlideRecord('x_demo_fieldsvc_technician');
            tech.addActiveQuery();
            tech.orderBy('u_open_tasks');
            tech.setLimit(1);
            tech.query();
            if (tech.next()) {
                workOrder.setValue('assigned_to', tech.getValue('user'));
            }
        } catch (err) {
            gs.error('WorkOrderHelper.assignTechnician failed: {0}', err.message);
        }
    },

    type: 'WorkOrderHelper'
};</script><sys_id>c0ffee0000000000000000000000000e</sys_id><sys_scope display_value="x_demo_fieldsvc">c0ffee00aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa01</sys_scope></sys_script_include></record_update>
